# volcenginecc_config_configuration_recorder (Data Source)

Data Source schema for Volcengine::Config::ConfigurationRecorder



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `configuration_recorder_status` (String) Configuration recorder status. Options: Disabled, PendingEnable, Building, Rebuilding, Enabled, PendingDisable
- `create_by` (String) Configuration recorder creation source
- `include_all_resource_types` (Boolean) Whether to record all supported resource types
- `include_resource_types` (Set of String) List of specified resource types to record
- `recorder_id` (String) Configuration recorder ID
- `recorder_name` (String) Configuration recorder name
- `recorder_type` (String) Configuration recorder type. Options: SingleAccount, Organization
